scope: Experimental1214ah on 1214ag (#14, #9): the NPC attack relay follows dynamic relevance like the combat channels. Bindings join and retire per NPC (relevance sync each tick, a 3 s block after retirement), a binding that does not negotiate in 5 s retires alone, contacts from not-ready bindings are dropped instead of stopping the relay, a peer re-arm restarts the sequence instead of stopping (peer_replaced), and the product controller re-arms a relay stopped outside checkpoint recovery after 3 s. Before, the relay bound only the NPCs present at start and stopped on any retirement or timeout (take 1258j: no_ready_actors / negotiation_timeout), so guards could not hurt the client for most of a mission.
